verdict.rationale: Trello is a kanban-style project management tool, not a code host or coding agent. Reviewing AI agent code diffs with line-level comments and having the agent iterate is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Trello itself ships code review or agent iteration; Power-Up, MCP and mobile mentions concern board and card features, not line-level code review.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
